title: The Blocker Must Take
setup: The knight on d7 is the only thing standing between your rook and d8.
hint: The knight will not leave that square by choice. What can you place where it is obliged to capture?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qb8+}} leaves Black one legal move: {{Nxb8}}. The blocker has been dragged off d7, and {{Rd8#}} mates down the road it was standing in. A piece that shuts a file is only a wall until a check calls it away.
